discrimination_axes.rule: Any SAME_OBJECT continuity across explicit upstream invalidation, declared role/geometry-kind change, split/merge parent disposition, or required-source discontinuity is a hard falsification for that candidate.

Measure candidate splits/genesis inside source stretches where hard scope remains constant, no terminal break exists, and candidate-independent owner geometry/relation constitution permits continued observation.
Measure candidate joins that bridge independently observable reconstitution or terminal-break anchors; no future outcomes, family labels, C3 semantics, or similarity scores may define an anchor.
Preserve all equally lawful competitors; compare ambiguity, no-correspondence, and contradiction counts rather than forcing nearest-neighbour identity.
Report metrics separately for 2021, 2022 and 2023, BID/ASK, 15M/2H_A_L, structural role and geometry kind; cross-stratum reversals remain visible.
Generate candidate-name-blind review cards from disagreement signatures. Labels are SAME, DIFFERENT, AMBIGUOUS or NOT_EVALUABLE under evidence available at cutoff.
C2E episode enrichment may not be claimed, activated, or used to favour C unless a separately governed episode-relative role declaration and successor candidate generation are operator-approved.

purpose: Discriminate false fragmentation from false continuity across frozen ObjectPack candidates A/B/C without selecting or activating a pack from compression, runtime efficiency, or unsupported semantic claims.

review_case_selection.rule: Build the full candidate-disagreement ledger first. For human review include all hard-violation cases plus one deterministic hash-min representative for every unique disagreement signature x year x side x clock x structural_role_id x geometry_kind_id, with immediate predecessor/successor context.

scientific_hypotheses.H_A_FALSE_FRAGMENTATION: Exact geometry-signature continuity may split one lawful persistent referent into many ObjectAssertions when geometry evolves without a terminal identity break.
scientific_hypotheses.H_B_FALSE_CONTINUITY: Relation-topology plus owner-declared geometry compatibility may join distinct structures across genuine identity breaks.
scientific_hypotheses.H_C_FALSE_CONTINUITY_OR_UNTESTED_ENRICHM: Current C2-only C semantics may be still more permissive than B, while its episode-enriched scientific intent remains untested because no episode-relative identity role is registered.

selection_logic.blind_error_matrix: For adjudicated SAME/DIFFERENT cases compute exact false-split and false-join counts. AMBIGUOUS and NOT_EVALUABLE remain separate denominators.
selection_logic.efficiency_rule: Object count, compression, wall time, memory and storage may not determine scientific selection.
selection_logic.pareto_rule: A candidate strictly worse or equal on both false-split and false-join counts and strictly worse on at least one is scientifically dominated.
selection_logic.recommendation_rule: Only a uniquely non-falsified, non-dominated candidate with no concealed year/side/clock failure may be recommended. Otherwise recommend DEFER.
